other_conditions: The unit must have obtained a patent or applied for a patent for the innovation.
The unit must have been functioning profitably for 3 years before the date of application.
At least 60% of the unit’s employment must be to people of the UT of Puducherry.
benefits_summary: Cash award of ₹2,00,000 and a citation.
documents_required: Copies of mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
